Sobresaliente. El único detalle es que limpian el baño a las 9 y se Congestiona todo. Porque la que limpia manda al otro baño y se hacen filas innecesarias cuando existe en el lugar un baño para discapacitados que no se usa.

(Translated by Google)
Outstanding. The only issue is that they clean the bathroom at 9 am, which causes a huge congestion. The cleaner directs people to the other bathroom, creating unnecessary lines, even though there's a disabled restroom nearby that isn't being used.
